subject: Urban Planning
title: Olympic White Elephants
description: A 60-second lesson on Olympic White Elephants.

hook.text: Athens spent $15 billion on the 2004 Olympics. Most venues are now abandoned and covered in graffiti.

buildup.text: Olympic host cities routinely build venues that serve no purpose after the games. Montreal took 30 years to pay off 1976.

discovery.text: Rio's 2016 Olympic Park is crumbling. The athlete village was supposed to become housing — most units sit empty.

twist.text: London 2012 is the rare success — the Olympic Park became housing, schools, and a permanent public space.

climax.text: Cities are now refusing to bid. The IOC struggles to find willing hosts as the costs become undeniable.

punchline.text: Two weeks of glory. Decades of empty stadiums.

quiz.question: Which Olympic host city is considered a rare post-Games planning success?
